Synopsis:
CINE ARTIST - PLEASE CONTACT WRITER RE. STRUCTURE - IT'S NOT THAT BAD, PROMISEDialog with Sarevok and his Murder Tribunal - will begin when approaching the Murder Tribunal in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. Sarevok will judge whether the player is worthy of receiving the title of "Unholy Assassin" - or tell the court to attack if we are deemed unworthy. If this part of the trial succeeds, the Tribunal will move on to the "Baptism of Blood" ritual (LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_BloodBaptism).

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_Trial.json: The scene takes place beneath Baldur’s Gate at the Murder Tribunal in the Bhaal‑temple, where Sarevok Anchev and his undead kin judge whether the player — a Bhaalspawn/Chosen — is worthy of the title “Unholy Assassin.” The Tribunal’s customs demand proof of deadly merit (notably that one Bhaal‑child must kill another), and Sarevok frames the court as punished, husked servants of Bhaal who preside over initiations into the cult. Off‑screen context: the player may already have slain one of Sarevok’s kin (samples even reference a killed “granddaughter”), which colors Sarevok’s gratitude, contempt, and the threat that failure will prompt the court to attack. If the player passes this trial the Tribunal will proceed to the next rite, the “Baptism of Blood.”
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Dolor.json: Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_DeathKnight.json: Dialog with the Death Knight sentry guarding the courtroom of the Murder Tribunal, in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. If you know that this is where you become an Unholy Assassin - and you have a victim's hand with you - he will let you through to be judged by the tribunal.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_AD_Sarevok_OnDeath.json: Death AD for Sarevok at the Murder Tribunal. Sarevok is presiding over the Murder Tribunal to judge Bhaalists who aspire to become Unholy Assassins. He will react differently, depending on how far the player has advanced in to the Murder Tribunal.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_Trespass.json: Trespass dialog for approaching the Murder Tribunal without becoming an Unholy Assassin. Sarevok will warn you.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Sarevok Anchev: O Hail, true Chosen. May you bring death wherever you walk. (node 1)
- Sarevok Anchev: You gaze upon your disgraced kin, those who were sacrificed where you were raised up. (node 330)
- Player: My idol, my hero, even in death. (node 135)
- Sarevok Anchev: Silence, spawn. Our undeaths are not to be admired. They are a punishment for our failures. (node 80)
- Sarevok Anchev: We honoured Bhaal with our deaths, but he dragged us into these husked forms, to bring the lash upon the Gate, and nurse his dread cult in its dormant years. (node 270)
- Sarevok Anchev: We preside over the Tribunal, which has initiated many assassins into the ranks in the Temple. Here we remain until another of our line ends time itself. (node 231)
- Player: And I will be that world-ender. (node 245)
- Sarevok Anchev: Unholy Chosen, of course you are above needing to prove yourself to the Tribunal. (node 364)
- Sarevok Anchev: But the truth of Bhaal's will remains. Any Bhaalspawn who can kill a Chosen has a hope of becoming the Chosen themselves. (node 41)
- Sarevok Anchev: I fear we must kill one another. It is Father's way. Two Children must not both leave a holy site alive. (node 309)
- Player: What a treat. Just like your granddaughter was, gargling on her own blood. (node 271)
- Sarevok Anchev: I thank you for killing my granddaughter. She could not have been dispatched by better. Nor could I. (node 76)
- Sarevok Anchev: My aching bones still feel every spark of pain from the crystalline moment of my death. (node 215)
- Sarevok Anchev: Even if I cannot defeat you, perhaps at last he will let me die. (node 97)
- Sarevok Anchev: Let us die, Chosen. As only Bhaalspawn can die. (node 132)

context: The scene occurs beneath Baldur’s Gate in the Bhaal‑temple’s Murder Tribunal, where Sarevok Anchev and his undead kin—presented as husked, punished servants of Bhaal—preside over initiations into the Unholy Assassins. The player is a Bhaalspawn (often treated as the “Chosen”) and must prove deadly merit under the Tribunal’s custom: one Bhaal‑child must kill another for a chance at the title. Off‑screen context: the player may already have slain one of Sarevok’s kin (references to a killed “granddaughter” appear in sample lines), which affects Sarevok’s gratitude, contempt, and his willingness to judge rather than immediately order the court to attack. If the player fails the trial the Tribunal will turn violent; if the player passes, the ritual sequence continues with the “Baptism of Blood.”
